scope_limits: This report independently reviews only these 16 declared-role cases and does not certify the overall 34-case live run.
All 16 source media observations are supplied typed Cards; actual perception accuracy is not established.

Passed covers role/identity/scene/audio permissions, actual final IR/prompt/manifest. Precise pixel/pose, active voice likeness, real beat sync, unseen video intervals and waveform mixing remain individually not_evaluable.
Run1 subject/environment role contamination and continuation model-contract failure are retained separately; these are fresh run2 artifacts under the new binary, not retries spliced into run1.
